title: ShiShan narrative system
summary: Turn structured natural-language annotations and an explicit project story into browsable code narratives for the Web and VS Code.

flows.title: Code narrative pipeline
flows.summary: Follow a source annotation from syntax-aware analysis to a live function-level narrative in the browser.

nodes.label: Annotated source code
nodes.summary: Developers or AI agents place structured @shishan comments beside the behavior they explain.

nodes.label: Analyze syntax and comments
nodes.summary: Tree-sitter binds narrative comments to functions, branches, loops, calls, errors, and fine-grained details.

nodes.label: Update the project index
nodes.summary: Only changed files are parsed while stable analyses are reused and project coverage is recalculated.

nodes.label: Publish snapshot and patches
nodes.summary: The local server exposes the current snapshot and broadcasts bounded incremental changes.

nodes.label: Apply live state
nodes.summary: The Web client initializes from a snapshot and merges later project or file patches.

nodes.label: Explore function stories
nodes.summary: Users inspect a function flow, its nested narrative steps, and the exact source lines behind each explanation.

flows.title: Project overview delivery
flows.summary: Follow the explicit whole-project story from its checked-in manifest to both visual interfaces and source navigation.

nodes.label: Project narrative manifest
nodes.summary: Maintainers define a small set of intentional cross-file flows instead of deriving a noisy graph from every file.

nodes.label: Validate and bind sources
nodes.summary: The core validates schema and topology, rejects unsafe paths, and resolves nodes to real files and symbols.

nodes.label: Attach story to project state
nodes.summary: The project index carries the validated overview and its diagnostics in snapshots and live patches.

nodes.label: Web Overview
nodes.summary: The default browser tab renders each named flow as a Mermaid-like directed graph with readable narrative cards.

nodes.label: VS Code Activity Bar
nodes.summary: The installed extension exposes the same flows in a dedicated ShiShan sidebar without requiring the Web view first.

nodes.label: Jump to implementation
nodes.summary: Selecting a project node opens its bound symbol or source range, connecting the overview to implementation details.
